lines.text: Saturday night in the Brass Cellar. Every chair is taken, and forty people are being quietly, gloriously loud.

lines.speaker: ruby
lines.text: Listen to that, kid. Thirty years I've waited for a room this full.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: (They came. Because of the posters. Because of me. Someone should pinch me, gently.)
Upstairs, something heavy hits the door with no handle. It does not knock twice.
The door gives way. Flashlight-white light pours down the stairs, and the colors drain out of the room.

lines.speaker: hush
lines.text: Brass Cellar. Unlicensed amplification, Section 9, Subsection Hum. Nobody leaves. Nobody plays. Nobody hums.

lines.speaker: mute
lines.text: Sergeant, the raid order did not come from the Mayor's office. It came from above that. I do not know who is above that.

lines.speaker: hush
lines.text: Above the Mayor is only the law, Mute. Stay calm. Stay measured.

lines.speaker: ruby
lines.text: Pip. Look at me. Behind the coat rack is a back door onto Fish Lane. Nobody's watching it yet.

lines.speaker: ruby
lines.text: Go to the harbor. Old Jonas keeps a room by the water. My horn case is by that door. Take it if you can carry it, and leave it if you can't.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Um. What about you? And everyone else?

lines.speaker: ruby
lines.text: They run faster than you, so don't try to outrun them. But they can't see round a corner. Break their sight, then lose yourself in a crowd.

lines.speaker: ruby
lines.text: The whole room is about to pour into the streets. Walk in the middle of them and nobody looks twice.

lines.speaker: ruby
lines.text: I've been thrown out of better places than this. Go.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: (Break their sight. Hide in a crowd. Carry the case, or don't. It's easy. It's easy. Nothing about this is easy.)
Behind the coat rack, a narrow door. Behind the door, Fish Lane, the rain, and a great many whistles.
